reason: 该插件的主旨是为 DSH Agent 提供 image_analyze 工具，把本地图片/URL/Data URL 发送至可配置的 OpenAI 兼容视觉接口并返回文本分析结果，属于面向媒体输入增强模型可视化能力的工具型扩展。

summaries.zh: dsh-vision 为 Agent 增加 image_analyze 工具，支持上传本地图片、链接或 data URL 到可配置视觉模型获取文字分析结果。
summaries.en: dsh-vision adds an image_analyze tool for Agent users to submit local images, URLs, or data URLs to a configurable vision model and receive text-based analysis results.

capabilities: Calls a remote OpenAI-compatible vision API to analyze images
Accepts images from local paths, HTTP(S) URLs, and data URLs
Converts image input for model consumption and returns text-based analysis
